_comment: Eval questions for Slice 2 retrieval harness. Each question has expectedFacts (substrings that must appear in the MCP response), category, and notes.

questions.question: Who are the contacts at Acme Corp?
questions.notes: Tests contact-to-company relationship retrieval

questions.question: What is the largest deal by amount?
questions.notes: Tests superlative retrieval — largest single deal

questions.question: What deals does Globex have?
questions.notes: Tests all deals linked to a company

questions.question: How many contacts are in the customer stage?
questions.notes: Tests aggregate count of contacts by stage

questions.question: What is Alice Johnson's title and company?
questions.notes: Tests single entity attribute retrieval with company relationship

questions.question: Which deals are currently in the negotiation stage?
questions.notes: Tests filtering deals by stage

questions.question: Who owns the Globex Enterprise Platform deal?
questions.notes: Tests deal owner lookup

questions.question: What is the total value of all closed_won deals?
questions.notes: Tests aggregate sum of deals by stage

questions.question: What companies are in the Manufacturing industry?
questions.notes: Tests filtering companies by industry

questions.question: What is Bob Chen's title and what company does he work at?
questions.notes: Tests contact attribute + company relationship

questions.question: Which deals does Sarah Kim own?
questions.notes: Tests deals owned by a specific sales rep

questions.question: What is the second largest deal?
questions.notes: Tests second-largest deal — superlative

questions.question: What is Quantum Systems' industry and number of employees?
questions.notes: Tests company attribute retrieval

questions.question: Which contacts work in New York?
questions.notes: Tests contacts at companies in New York (indirect — via company city)

questions.question: How many deals are in the proposal stage?
questions.notes: Tests count of deals by stage

questions.question: What deals does Zenith Capital have and what are their amounts?
questions.notes: Tests all deals for a company with amounts

questions.question: Who are the contacts at Forge Manufacturing and what are their titles?
questions.notes: Tests multiple contacts at a company with titles

questions.question: What is the Quantum Security Platform deal worth and what stage is it in?
questions.notes: Tests deal attribute lookup by name

questions.question: Which companies have more than 200 employees?
questions.notes: Tests companies filtered by employee count (superlative threshold)

questions.question: What is the BlueSky MES Upgrade deal amount and who owns it?
questions.notes: Tests deal amount + owner lookup

questions.question: What deals has Tom Garcia closed?
questions.notes: Tests closed deals by sales rep

questions.question: Which companies are in the Finance or Financial Services industries?
questions.notes: Tests industry filter across related categories
